column1: 1.  Unless constituent notifies the bank immediately of any discrepancy found by him/her in his/her statement of Account, it will be taken that he/she has found the account correct.

2. Computer generated entries shown in the statement of account do not require any authentication / initial from a bank official. Please do not accept any manual entries in your computer generated statement of account.
3. Please ensure that all the cheques leaves in your custody are duly branded with your 16 digits account number.
4.  Customers are requested, in their own interest, not to issue cheques without adequate clear funds / arrangements. Such cheques can be returned without making any further reference to them.
5. Please maintain minimum average balance, to avoid levy of charges.

6. Please note Penal interest may be charged in loan accounts due to financial reasons such as over drawings, non receipt of installments on the rates prescribed by bank from time to time and for non financial reasons like non-submission of QMS forms, non-adherence to the terms and conditions etc.

7. Abbreviations are as under:
 BR: Branch Name , Csh: Cash , Clg: Clearing , ISO: Inter Sol(##)
 QAB:Quarterly Average Balances , LF Chg: Ledger Folio Charges , Intt: Interest , Chrg: Charges
 Ret:Returning , Chq: Cheque , SI: Standing Instruction , Stk Stmt: Stock Statement , Trf: Transfer , POSP:POINT OF SALE
